judgments.reason: The span 'Multiple fungal hyphae identified' appears literally in the brain lesion pathology section and directly supports disseminated aspergillosis by confirming fungal invasion at a site (brain) distant from the lung primary.

The span 'Inflammatory cell infiltrates and fibrin-like exudates' appears literally in the lung biopsy section, but it describes non-specific inflammatory findings without identifying fungal organisms; it does not clinically support the 'disseminated' modifier, as it neither confirms aspergillosis at the lung site nor demonstrates spread to a second organ.

The span 'Substantial mass in left lung with pleural invasion, showing irregular mass with lobulation, spiculation, and pleural invasion' appears literally in the chest CT description, but these imaging features are non-specific and more suggestive of malignancy; they do not clinically support the 'disseminated' modifier for aspergillosis without pathological confirmation of fungal infection at this site.

The span 'Left parietal occupying lesion MRI' appears literally in the imaging section title and supports dissemination by identifying a brain lesion (confirmed as fungal on pathology) as a second organ site of involvement beyond the lung.
